connector.name: Stride20k x402 Data Gateway
connector.registryDescription: x402 analytics feed + 20+ pay-per-call agent tools over x402 (data, LLM, risk), no accounts.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package x402-gateway-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the marysbrain account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Buyer wallet key (fund with a few USDC on Base). Optional: free previews work without it.

env.name: MAX_PER_CALL_USD
env.description: Refuse any single call above this price. Default 0.25; set 1.25 to enable the $1 domain dossier.

env.name: MAX_SESSION_USD
env.description: Total spend cap per session. Default 2.00.

env.name: GATEWAY_URL
env.description: Gateway base URL override. Default https://gateway.stride20k.com.
